active_loop.seed: One label-informed positive and one negative minimizing SHA-256(review NUL canonical record identity), positive first.
active_loop.tie_rule: Stable descending scores over ascending canonical record-identity order.

decision_rule: Admit only U4_PLUS_TITLE_A250 and only if G1-G9 all pass. Otherwise discard the title residual and retain exact u4. TITLE_ONLY_U4 is a frozen ablation, not a substitute admission route.
execution_limit: One execution of the frozen three-arm diagnostic; no grid, tuning, retry, pytest or repository CI.
forbidden_claims: source-general, domain-general, workflow-general or application-exact superiority

frozen_arms.EXACT_U4: Exact V8/V7 u4 word TF-IDF, LinearSVC C=0.11 squared_hinge random_state=20260823, 9.8 balancer and unchanged active loop.
frozen_arms.TITLE_ONLY_U4: Title-emphasis representation title + title + abstract with the same exact u4 learner, balancer and active loop.
frozen_arms.U4_PLUS_TITLE_A250: At every active batch, separately population-z-score exact-u4 and title-only pool scores and rank by z_u4 + 0.25*(z_title-z_u4).

source_population.canonicalization: Whitespace-normalize title and abstract; drop empty text; within review retain lexicographically smallest record_id for duplicate normalized title-abstract content; remove every content identity in SWIFT, the five V5 decisions, KIFMS V7, or more than one V9 review before labels are opened.
source_population.retention: All seven frozen reviews must bind, contain both classes after label-blind exclusions, and execute. Any failure is CANNOT_CHECK; no review deletion.
source_population.unit: review decision, unweighted across exactly seven reviews

unchanged_gates.G1_BINDING: All exact source, freeze, V8 result/adjudication/discriminator/runner and pinned active-core hashes match.
unchanged_gates.G2_SOURCE_CONTENT_AND_POPULATION: All seven frozen populations bind, are content-disjoint from SWIFT/V5/KIFMS and each other, and contain both classes.
